Omron

Complete BP7900

Upper-arm blood pressure monitor with ECG for clinical-grade home heart screening.

FDA Cleared Home BP + EKG

The Omron Complete™ BP7900 combines upper-arm blood pressure measurement with EKG recording, including AFib detection support — a trusted FDA-cleared home heart monitoring option.

What It Measures

  • Blood Pressure
  • EKG
  • Afib Detection
  • Bluetooth connectivity

Key Specifications

  • Upper-arm cuff blood pressure measurement
  • Single-lead EKG recording capability
  • AFib detection support during readings
  • Bluetooth sync to companion app
  • Designed for simple at-home use

Clearance & Use

  • FDA Cleared
  • Home hypertension management
  • Heart rhythm screening support
  • Pairs with clinical care pathways

Ideal for patients needing accurate home BP and ECG screening. Discuss availability during your free consultation.
